description: Mystical Penumbra logo with living radial gradient orb. The central penumbra form is a single compound path of concentric rings filled by an animated radialGradient. Each of the four color band stops animates independently with staggered timings — inner/core beats on pulse-core, mid-band on pulse-mid, outer accent on pulse-outer, and edge glow on pulse-edge. These independent rhythms create the illusion the rings themselves are breathing, without any geometry changes. A slow gradientTransform rotation (drift-spin) makes the focal hotspot drift like celestial light. A glow filter (blur-glow, opacity-glow) adds luminous depth beneath the rings. The whole orb fades on pulse-core as the ambient breath envelope. Text holds crisp and warm with a hair-thin blur halo.

palette_groups.note: Deep cosmic purple — innermost ring band. Canonical #563c70. Tight entropy: keeps the dark mystical gravity of the center.
Rich amber-orange transition band. Canonical #e1813b. Low entropy: warm ember arc.
Bright fiery orange outer ring peak. Canonical #ff902f. Low entropy: stays within vivid solar orange.
Electric teal-cyan outer edge and glow filter. Canonical #8be4d9. Medium entropy: can drift cooler (mint) or warmer (aquamarine).
Crisp warm-white metallic for logo text. Very tight — must stay near-white for legibility.

motion_groups.note: Primary breath envelope — drives both the inner stop color cycle AND the overall orb opacity animate. Slowest rhythm: sets the big cosmic inhale/exhale.
Mid-band stop color cycle — color-warm ↔ color-accent. Slightly faster than core so rings appear to ripple inward/outward at different rates.
Outer accent + 81% stop color/opacity cycle — color-accent ↔ color-glow. Faster still: the bright outer ring crackles with most life.
Edge glow stop cycle — color-glow ↔ color-core. Runs at its own rate so the teal halo fades in and out independently of the orange bands.
begin offset (seconds) applied to mid and outer stop animations so they start out of phase with core — prevents all bands from peaking simultaneously and creates the organic ripple feel.
Full period (seconds) of the gradientTransform rotation — makes the radial focal point orbit the orb center, causing the light source to appear to drift cosmically across the rings.

vars.name: color-core
vars.note: Deep cosmic purple. Inner 0% and 13% gradient stops. Also used as exchange target in pulse-edge animation (glow ↔ core).

vars.name: color-warm
vars.note: Amber-orange transition. 33% stop. Cycles toward color-accent during pulse-mid.

vars.name: color-accent
vars.note: Bright fiery orange. 75% and 81% stops. Also start value for core-breath cycle (color-core ↔ color-warm).

vars.name: color-glow
vars.note: Electric teal-cyan. 94% and 100% edge stops, and feFlood color in glow filter. Cycles toward color-core during pulse-edge.

vars.name: color-text
vars.note: Warm near-white for logo letterforms. Kept tight to preserve legibility at all times.

vars.name: blur-glow
vars.note: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation on the orb glow filter. Low = tight halo; high = diffuse cosmic bloom.

vars.name: opacity-glow
vars.note: feFlood flood-opacity in glow filter. Controls how intensely the teal halo radiates beneath the rings.

vars.name: opacity-lo
vars.note: Orb opacity at exhale trough — the 'from' value of the orb breath animate. Keeps the rings visible even at minimum.

vars.name: opacity-hi
vars.note: Orb opacity at inhale peak — the 'to' value. Full presence.

vars.name: pulse-core
vars.note: Period (seconds) of inner stop color cycle AND overall orb opacity breath. The master heartbeat. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-mid
vars.note: Period of 33% mid-band stop color animation. Should differ from pulse-core for ripple effect. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-outer
vars.note: Period of 75%/81% outer stop color + opacity animation. Fastest band — outer ring has most visible life. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-edge
vars.note: Period of 94%/100% edge glow stop color + opacity animation. Independent from orange bands. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: pulse-offset
vars.note: begin delay (seconds) for mid and outer stop animations — creates phase offset so bands don't all peak together. Template appends 's'.

vars.name: drift-spin
vars.note: Full rotation period (seconds) of gradientTransform animateTransform on the radial gradient. Makes the focal light source orbit the orb center. Very slow feels celestial; faster feels energetic. Template appends 's'.
